#this code matches the MCI and DOC causes of death to the template by matching cause_general and cause_specific information (illness, drug, homicide, suicide, etc.) with a standardized, predicted final_cause
```{r libraries and data}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(reticulate)
py_require("pandas")
py_require("numpy")
py_require("openpyxl")
py_require("rapidfuzz")

template<-read_xlsx("code/cod_algorithm/a_02_COD Coding Input template.xlsx")
combined<-read_rds("data/a_02_mortality_data_post_processed/combined_mortality_data.rds")

```



fitting combined dataset into template 1 where cause = COD general and specific (concatenated) 
```{r fitting}
 template1 <- combined %>%
  transmute(
    CASE_NUMBER = case_number,
    CAUSE = paste(
      cause_general,
      coalesce(
        illspec,
        drugspec,
        homispec,
        suicspec,
        selfspec,
        accspec,
        otherspec,
        cause_specific
      ),
      sep = ": "
    )
  )

#checking to make sure missingness pattern matches combined dataset 
template1%>%filter(is.na(CAUSE))%>%count() #0
template1%>%count(CAUSE, sort= TRUE)
template1$CAUSE[template1$CAUSE == "NA: NA"]<-NA 
template1%>%filter(is.na(CAUSE))%>%count() #4249


#cleaning template to shorten cause_general SUICIDE description 
template1 %>%count(CAUSE, sort = TRUE)

template1$CAUSE <- sub(
  "^Suicide.*?:",
  "Suicide:",
  template1$CAUSE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

#doing same for aids related illness
template1$CAUSE <- sub(
  "^Illness.*?:",
  "Illness:",
  template1$CAUSE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)



write_xlsx(template1, "code/cod_algorithm/z_archived/COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx")
```

putting template through an algorithm that assigns standardized COD output
```{python levelsmatch}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from rapidfuzz import fuzz
import re


# ============================================================
# CONFIG
# ============================================================

excel_file_name = "code/cod_algorithm/z_archived/COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx"
sub_sheet = "Sheet1"

keywords_excel = "code/cod_algorithm/a_03_final_kw_v1.xlsx"
kw_sub_sheet = "kw_icd_categories"

FUZZY_THRESHOLD = 85


# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

df = pd.read_excel(
    excel_file_name,
    sheet_name=sub_sheet,
    engine="openpyxl"
)

df["CAUSE"] = (
    df["CAUSE"]
    .fillna("")
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .str.upper()
)


# ============================================================
# LOAD KEYWORDS
# ============================================================

kw_df = pd.read_excel(
    keywords_excel,
    sheet_name=kw_sub_sheet,
    engine="openpyxl"
)


def clean(col):
    return (
        kw_df[col]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .str.upper()
        .str.strip()
        .tolist()
    )


od_keywords = clean("OVERDOSE KEYWORDS")
cold_keywords = clean("COLD KEYWORDS")
heat_keywords = clean("HEAT KEYWORDS")
suicide_keywords = clean("SUICIDE KEYWORDS")
homicide_keywords = clean("HOMICIDE KEYWORDS")
cardio_keywords = clean("CARDIOVASCULAR KEYWORDS")
resp_keywords = clean("RESPIRATORY KEYWORDS")
ca_keywords = clean("CANCERS KEYWORDS")
neuro_keywords = clean("NEUROPSYCHIATRIC KEYWORDS")
covid_keywords = clean("COVID-19 KEYWORDS")
comm_keywords = clean("COMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS")
non_comm_keywords = clean("NONCOMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS")
acc_keywords = clean("ACCIDENTAL KEYWORDS")
external_keywords = clean("INJURY KEYWORDS")
internal_keywords = clean("INTERNAL KEYWORDS")
unk_keywords = clean("UNDETERMINED")


# ============================================================
# CAUSE FOR CLASSIFICATION
# ============================================================

df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"] = df["CAUSE"]

missing_cause = df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"].eq("")


# ============================================================
# INITIAL FLAGS
# ============================================================

flags = [
    "FINAL_OD",
    "FINAL_COLD",
    "FINAL_HEAT",
    "FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_CARDIO",
    "FINAL_RESP",
    "FINAL_CA",
    "FINAL_NEURO",
    "FINAL_COVID",
    "FINAL_COMM_DISEASE",
    "FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE",
    "FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_UNDETERMINED",
    "FINAL_EXTERNAL",
    "FINAL_INTERNAL"
]

for f in flags:
    df[f] = False


# ============================================================
# ALL CAUSE GROUPS
# ============================================================

cause_groups = {
    "FINAL_OD": od_keywords,
    "FINAL_COLD": cold_keywords,
    "FINAL_HEAT": heat_keywords,
    "FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE": suicide_keywords,
    "FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE": homicide_keywords,
    "FINAL_CARDIO": cardio_keywords,
    "FINAL_RESP": resp_keywords,
    "FINAL_CA": ca_keywords,
    "FINAL_NEURO": neuro_keywords,
    "FINAL_COVID": covid_keywords,
    "FINAL_COMM_DISEASE": comm_keywords,
    "FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE": non_comm_keywords,
    "FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE": acc_keywords,
    "FINAL_EXTERNAL": external_keywords,
    "FINAL_INTERNAL": internal_keywords,
    "FINAL_UNDETERMINED": unk_keywords
}


# ============================================================
# ORIGINAL LEVEL 3 CATEGORIES
# ============================================================
#
# IMPORTANT:
# Only these categories are used for:
#
#   MATCH_COUNT
#   MATCHED_KEYWORDS
#   CLASS_LEVEL_3_A
#   CLASS_LEVEL_3_B
#
# Structural categories such as FINAL_INTERNAL and
# FINAL_EXTERNAL are NOT included here.
# ============================================================

level3_groups = {
    "FINAL_COLD": cold_keywords,
    "FINAL_HEAT": heat_keywords,
    "FINAL_OD": od_keywords,
    "FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE": acc_keywords,
    "FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE": suicide_keywords,
    "FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE": homicide_keywords,
    "FINAL_COVID": covid_keywords,
    "FINAL_COMM_DISEASE": comm_keywords,
    "FINAL_CA": ca_keywords,
    "FINAL_CARDIO": cardio_keywords,
    "FINAL_RESP": resp_keywords,
    "FINAL_NEURO": neuro_keywords,
    "FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE": non_comm_keywords
}


# ============================================================
# LEVEL 3 LABELS
# ============================================================

class3_labels = {
    "FINAL_COLD": "Cold-related death",
    "FINAL_HEAT": "Heat-related death",
    "FINAL_OD": "Overdose",
    "FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE": "Other Accidental",
    "FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE": "Suicide",
    "FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE": "Homicide",
    "FINAL_COVID": "COVID-19",
    "FINAL_COMM_DISEASE": "Other Communicable Disease",
    "FINAL_CA": "Cancer",
    "FINAL_CARDIO": "Cardiovascular Disease",
    "FINAL_RESP": "Respiratory Disease",
    "FINAL_NEURO": "Neuropsychiatric Conditions",
    "FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE": "Other Non-Communicable Disease"
}


# ============================================================
# EXISTING MATCH TRACKING
# ============================================================

df["MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = ""
df["MATCH_SCORE"] = np.nan
df["MATCH_TYPE"] = ""


# ============================================================
# NEW LEVEL 3 TRACKING
# ============================================================

df["MATCH_COUNT"] = 0
df["MATCHED_KEYWORDS"] = ""
df["CLASS_LEVEL_3_A"] = ""
df["CLASS_LEVEL_3_B"] = ""


# ============================================================
# PART 1:
# ORIGINAL CLASSIFICATION MATCHING
# ============================================================
#
# This preserves the original purpose of the algorithm:
# find keywords and set the appropriate FINAL_* flags.
#
# This includes structural categories such as INTERNAL and
# EXTERNAL because those are needed for Level 1/2.
# ============================================================

for flag, kws in cause_groups.items():

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # EXACT MATCHES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for kw in kws:

        mask = (
            df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"]
            .str.contains(
                rf"\b{re.escape(kw)}\b",
                na=False,
                regex=True
            )
        )

        df.loc[mask, flag] = True


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # FUZZY FALLBACK
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    mask = (
        (df[flag] == False) &
        (df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"] != "")
    )


    for idx, text in df.loc[
        mask,
        "CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"
    ].items():

        best_kw = None
        best_score = 0

        for kw in kws:

            score = fuzz.token_set_ratio(
                text,
                kw
            )

            if score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                best_kw = kw


        if best_score >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD:

            df.loc[idx, flag] = True


# ============================================================
# PART 2:
# LEVEL 3 MATCH TRACKING ONLY
# ============================================================
#
# This is completely separate from the classification above.
#
# ONLY Level 3 keyword groups are searched.
#
# Matches are ordered by where the keyword first appears in
# the original CAUSE text.
# ============================================================

for idx, text in df["CAUSE_FOR_CLASS"].items():

    if text == "":
        continue


    level3_matches = []


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # SEARCH ONLY LEVEL 3 GROUPS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for flag, kws in level3_groups.items():

        exact_matches_for_group = []


        # ====================================================
        # EXACT MATCHES
        # ====================================================

        for kw in kws:

            match = re.search(
                rf"\b{re.escape(kw)}\b",
                text
            )

            if match:

                exact_matches_for_group.append({
                    "keyword": kw,
                    "flag": flag,
                    "score": 100,
                    "type": "Exact",
                    "position": match.start()
                })


        # Add exact matches
        level3_matches.extend(
            exact_matches_for_group
        )


        # ====================================================
        # FUZZY FALLBACK
        # ====================================================

        # Only perform fuzzy matching if this Level 3 group
        # had no exact match.

        if len(exact_matches_for_group) == 0:

            best_kw = None
            best_score = 0

            for kw in kws:

                score = fuzz.token_set_ratio(
                    text,
                    kw
                )

                if score > best_score:

                    best_score = score
                    best_kw = kw


            if best_score >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD:

                level3_matches.append({
                    "keyword": best_kw,
                    "flag": flag,
                    "score": best_score,
                    "type": "Fuzzy",
                    "position": float("inf")
                })


    # ========================================================
    # REMOVE DUPLICATE KEYWORDS
    # ========================================================
    #
    # If the same keyword appears multiple times in the text,
    # count it only once.
    #
    # The first occurrence determines its position.
    # ========================================================

    unique_matches = {}


    for match in level3_matches:

        keyword = match["keyword"]


        if keyword not in unique_matches:

            unique_matches[keyword] = match

        elif match["position"] < unique_matches[keyword]["position"]:

            unique_matches[keyword] = match


    # ========================================================
    # SORT BY FIRST APPEARANCE
    # ========================================================

    level3_matches = sorted(
        unique_matches.values(),
        key=lambda x: x["position"]
    )


    # ========================================================
    # NO LEVEL 3 MATCHES
    # ========================================================

    if len(level3_matches) == 0:
        continue


    # ========================================================
    # MATCH COUNT
    # ========================================================

    df.loc[idx, "MATCH_COUNT"] = len(
        level3_matches
    )


    # ========================================================
    # MATCHED KEYWORDS
    # ========================================================

    matched_keywords = [
        match["keyword"]
        for match in level3_matches
    ]

    df.loc[idx, "MATCHED_KEYWORDS"] = (
        " | ".join(matched_keywords)
    )


    # ========================================================
    # LEVEL 3 A
    # ========================================================

    primary = level3_matches[0]

    df.loc[idx, "CLASS_LEVEL_3_A"] = (
        class3_labels[primary["flag"]]
    )


    # ========================================================
    # LEVEL 3 B
    # ========================================================

    secondary = level3_matches[1:]


    if len(secondary) > 0:

        secondary_classes = [
            class3_labels[match["flag"]]
            for match in secondary
        ]


        # Remove duplicate Level 3 categories while keeping
        # their original order.

        secondary_classes = list(
            dict.fromkeys(secondary_classes)
        )


        df.loc[idx, "CLASS_LEVEL_3_B"] = (
            " | ".join(secondary_classes)
        )


    # ========================================================
    # EXISTING MATCHED_KEYWORD
    # ========================================================
    #
    # Keep the original column as the first Level 3 match.
    # ========================================================

    df.loc[idx, "MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = (
        primary["keyword"]
    )

    df.loc[idx, "MATCH_SCORE"] = (
        primary["score"]
    )

    df.loc[idx, "MATCH_TYPE"] = (
        primary["type"]
    )


# ============================================================
# CAUSE STRUCTURE
# ============================================================

df["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"] = (
    df["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"] |
    df["FINAL_CARDIO"] |
    df["FINAL_RESP"] |
    df["FINAL_CA"] |
    df["FINAL_NEURO"]
)


df["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"] = (
    df["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"] |
    df["FINAL_COVID"]
)


df["FINAL_CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL"] = (
    df["FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE"] |
    df["FINAL_OD"] |
    df["FINAL_COLD"] |
    df["FINAL_HEAT"]
)


df["FINAL_CAUSE_INTENTIONAL"] = (
    df["FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE"] |
    df["FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE"]
)


df["FINAL_EXTERNAL"] = (
    df["FINAL_EXTERNAL"] |
    df["FINAL_CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL"] |
    df["FINAL_CAUSE_INTENTIONAL"]
)


df["FINAL_INTERNAL"] = (
    df["FINAL_INTERNAL"] |
    df["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"] |
    df["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"]
)


# ============================================================
# UNDETERMINED
# ============================================================

specific_cause_cols = [
    "FINAL_COMM_DISEASE",
    "FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE",
    "FINAL_EXTERNAL",
    "FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE",
    "FINAL_OD",
    "FINAL_COLD",
    "FINAL_HEAT",
    "FINAL_CARDIO",
    "FINAL_RESP",
    "FINAL_CA",
    "FINAL_NEURO",
    "FINAL_COVID"
]


df["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"] = (
    df["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"] |
    ~df[specific_cause_cols]
        .fillna(False)
        .any(axis=1)
)



# ============================================================
# FINAL CAUSE
# ============================================================

def get_final_cause(row):

    if row["FINAL_OD"]:
        return "OVERDOSE"

    if row["FINAL_COLD"]:
        return "COLD"

    if row["FINAL_HEAT"]:
        return "HEAT"

    if row["FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE"]:
        return "SUICIDE"

    if row["FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE"]:
        return "HOMICIDE"

    if row["FINAL_CARDIO"]:
        return "CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASE"

    if row["FINAL_RESP"]:
        return "RESPIRATORY DISEASE"

    if row["FINAL_CA"]:
        return "CANCER"

    if row["FINAL_NEURO"]:
        return "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC ILLNESS"

    if row["FINAL_COVID"]:
        return "COVID-19"

    if row["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "COMMUNICABLE DISEASE"

    if row["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "NON-COMMUNICABLE DISEASE"

    if row["FINAL_CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL"]:
        return "ACCIDENTAL"

    if row["FINAL_EXTERNAL"]:
        return "EXTERNAL"

    if row["FINAL_INTERNAL"]:
        return "INTERNAL"

    if row["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "UNDETERMINED"

    return "UNDETERMINED"


df["FINAL_CAUSE"] = df.apply(
    get_final_cause,
    axis=1
)


# ============================================================
# LEVEL 1
# ============================================================

def get_level1(row):

    if row["FINAL_EXTERNAL"]:
        return "External/Injury (Unnatural Death)"

    if row["FINAL_INTERNAL"]:
        return "Internal (Natural Death)"

    if row["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "Undetermined"

    return "Undetermined"


# ============================================================
# LEVEL 2
# ============================================================

def get_level2(row):

    if row["FINAL_CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL"]:
        return "Accidental"

    if row["FINAL_CAUSE_INTENTIONAL"]:
        return "Intentional"

    if row["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Communicable Disease"

    if row["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Non-Communicable Disease"

    if row["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "Undetermined"

    return "Undetermined"


# ============================================================
# LEVEL 3
# ============================================================

def get_level3(row):

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # External -> Accidental
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if row["FINAL_COLD"]:
        return "Cold-related death"

    if row["FINAL_HEAT"]:
        return "Heat-related death"

    if row["FINAL_OD"]:
        return "Overdose"

    if row["FINAL_ACCIDENTAL_CAUSE"]:
        return "Other Accidental"


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # External -> Intentional
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if row["FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE"]:
        return "Suicide"

    if row["FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE"]:
        return "Homicide"


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Internal -> Communicable
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if row["FINAL_COVID"]:
        return "COVID-19"

    if row["FINAL_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Other Communicable Disease"


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Internal -> Non-Communicable
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if row["FINAL_CA"]:
        return "Cancer"

    if row["FINAL_CARDIO"]:
        return "Cardiovascular Disease"

    if row["FINAL_RESP"]:
        return "Respiratory Disease"

    if row["FINAL_NEURO"]:
        return "Neuropsychiatric Conditions"

    if row["FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Other Non-Communicable Disease"


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Undetermined
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if row["FINAL_UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "Undetermined"

    return "Undetermined"


df["CLASS_LEVEL_1"] = df.apply(
    get_level1,
    axis=1
)

df["CLASS_LEVEL_2"] = df.apply(
    get_level2,
    axis=1
)

df["CLASS_LEVEL_3"] = df.apply(
    get_level3,
    axis=1
)


# ============================================================
# EXPORT
# ============================================================

df.to_excel(
    "code/cod_algorithm/b_02_full_results_ICD.xlsx",
    index=False
)
```

#combining cod output with combined_mortality_data
```{r combining}
output$case_number<-output$CASE_NUMBER
output$final_cause<-output$FINAL_CAUSE
output$class_level_1<-output$CLASS_LEVEL_1
output$class_level_2<-output$CLASS_LEVEL_2
output$class_level_3<-output$CLASS_LEVEL_3
output$matched_keyword<-output$MATCHED_KEYWORD

combined<-combined%>%select(-matched_keyword.x, -matched_keyword.y, -class_level_1.x, -class_level_2.x, -class_level_3.x, -class_level_1.y, -class_level_2.y, -class_level_3.y, -class_level_1, -class_level_2, -class_level_3)

combined<-combined%>%select(-matched_keyword, -final_cause)

hcmd <- combined %>%
  left_join(
    output %>%
      select(case_number, matched_keyword, class_level_1, class_level_2, class_level_3),
    by = "case_number"
  )

saveRDS(hcmd, "data/hcmd.rds")

```
